source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of evidence from comparative anatomy (PDF 220-221).

blocks.text: Comparative anatomy ke mahireen fossils aur zinda jandaron ki banawat parh kar aisi mushabihat dhoondte hain jo irtiqai rishte batayein. Is se do qisam ke evolution saamne aate hain.

items: Divergent evolution: homologous dhaanche banawat mein milte julte lekin kaam mein mukhtalif hain (homology). Homologous dhaanchon wale jandaron ka mushtarka buzurg hai aur unhon ne inhein mukhtalif kaamon ke liye use karna seekha; vertebrates ke agle aaza mein haddiyon ki aik hi tarteeb hai halanke yeh urne (parinde aur chamgadar), tairne (whales aur dolphins), daurne (ghore), charhne (darakhti chhipkaliyan) ya shaakhon se jhoolne ke liye use hote hain.

Convergent evolution: analogous aaza kaam mein milte julte lekin banawat mein mukhtalif hain, aur mukhtalif buzurgon se mukhtalif jandaron mein bane. Parinde aur keere ke par dono urne dete hain lekin homologous nahi; un ki mushabihat sirf yeh batati hai ke urne ke liye chauri, chapti satah chahiye.

blocks.alt: Chhe vertebrates ke agle aaza (forelimbs), aik jaisi haddiyan aik jaise rang mein: humerus gehra maroon, radius halka narangi, ulna surmai, kalai ki haddiyan surkh, haath ki haddiyan safaid. Insani baazu, paanch ungliyan 1 se 5; ghore ki taang, sirf ungli 3; chamgadar ka par, paanch lambi ungliyan 1 se 5 jhilli ke saath; parinde ka par, ungliyan 1, 2, 3 aur par (feathers); chhipkali ki taang, panjon wali paanch ungliyan 1 se 5; whale ka flipper, lambi ungliyan 1 se 4 ke number ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 24.5: Vertebrates ke agle aaza mein homology (kitab ki Figure 24.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Rang dekhein: har jaanwar mein upar aik haddi (humerus, maroon), phir do haddiyan (radius narangi, ulna surmai), phir kalai (surkh) aur ungliyan (safaid). Kaam alag hai (pakarna, daurna, urna, tairna) lekin haddiyon ki tarteeb aik hai; yahi homology hai jo mushtarka buzurg ki nishani hai. Ungliyon ke number batate hain ke ghore mein sirf teesri ungli bachi aur parinde mein teen.

Jandar aksar aise dhaanche rakhte hain jin ki afadiyat khatam ho chuki ho; yeh kam taraqqi yafta dhaanche vestigial kehlate hain. Kuch saanpon, jaise boa aur python, mein apne reptile buzurgon ki pichhli taangon (pelvic) ki haddiyon ke nanhe nishan hain. Kabhi mufeed dhaanchon ke aise nishan evolution ki wazeh alamat hain.

blocks.title: Insanon mein vestigial dhaanche
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke insani jism mein taqreeban 90 vestigial dhaanche hain, maslan vermiform appendix (caecum ka nishan), coccyx ya dum ki haddi (dum ka baqiya), aql daarh (vestigial teesri daarhein jo buzurg paudon ki ghiza peesne ke liye use karte the) aur kaan ke muscles jo bohat kam taraqqi yafta hain halanke kuch log kaan hila sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Chamgadar ka par aur whale ka flipper homologous hain ya analogous?
blocks.explanation: Homologous: un mein haddiyon ki aik hi tarteeb hai lekin mukhtalif kaamon (urna aur tairna) ke liye use hote hain.

items: Homologous: aik banawat, mukhtalif kaam: divergent evolution.
Analogous: aik kaam, mukhtalif banawat: convergent evolution.
Vestigial dhaanche (python ki pelvic haddiyan, insani appendix) maazi ki tabdeeli dikhate hain.
